label: TP
reason: User-controlled Referer header flows through URL decoding into doSomething() where param is copied to bar and returned. The bar value is then used in response.getWriter().format() which treats the third argument as a format string pattern. Without proper HTML escaping or sanitization before reaching the writable stream, user input can cause XSS via format string manipulation.

evidence.note: Referer header -> decode -> doSomething -> format sink without proper escaping
